activity.notes: Louis-Napoléon Bonaparte became Napoleon III, Emperor of the French, when the Second Empire was proclaimed in 1852; imperial rule ended with the regime's collapse in September 1870.

sources.title: Louis-Napoléon Bonaparte — Élysée
sources.citation_text: The Élysée chronology states that the Second Empire began on 2 December 1852 and that the Republic was proclaimed on 4 September 1870 after Napoleon III's capture at Sedan.
